name: Alert
description: Initiative Proficiency: add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative rolls. Initiative Swap: swap Initiative with a willing ally after rolling.

effects.reason: edits another actor's initiative during combat setup

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Choose the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list: learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell (cast once per Long Rest without a slot); Int, Wis, or Cha is the casting ability.

name: Defense
description: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
